- Focal opacities were identified in the lung apex and base in specific reports.
- Lung lesions including calcified granulomas and a potential nodule were documented.
- Heart size and pleural spaces were described as normal or clear in all instances.
- Skeletal findings were limited to degenerative changes and multiple myeloma rather than acute fractures.
